// diagnostic

E0705

`= "rust::path"` doesn't match the Jet signature

What

`= "rust::path"` doesn't match the Jet signature

Why

The registered jet rule applies here

Fix

Make the Rust path and Jet signature agree.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0705: tests/ui/ffi_bad_path.stderr.

Error [E0705]: The Rust item doesn't match the Jet signature at `bad` in `extern rust "base64@0.22"`
 Why: The `= "rust::path"` on an `extern rust` line must name a safe Rust function whose parameters and return type match what you wrote
 Fix: Check the path and types on `bad` in `extern rust "base64@0.22"`, or pick a different Rust function
